# colvmn

> A minimal static-site layout engine.

Site build: colvmn · 2026-11-13 · 7ff7970

## AI Reviews

- [AI Reviews](/ai-reviews/): Claude, ChatGPT, Gemini and Grok review your site, or any section of it, from its own docs. One setting per page and an API key; colvmn does the rest.

## Authoring

- [Authoring](/authoring/)

## How It Works

## Quick Start

- [Quick Start](/quick-start/)

## Scheduled Updates

- [Scheduled Updates](/scheduled-updates/): Pages that refresh themselves. A folder with an update file runs a script or a prompt on a schedule, or when what it watches changes, and publishes the result.
